commands.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo TARGETED_MODAL_TESTS
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec vitest run src/features/thermometers/components/SensorRemovalBlockedModal.test.tsx src/features/plugs/components/PlugDeleteConfirmModal.test.tsx src/__tests__/modal.test.tsx --reporter=default
echo FULL_CHECK
pnpm check > /tmp/shelly-ionic-205-full-check.log 2>&1 || {
  echo FULL_CHECK_FAILED; tail -90 /tmp/shelly-ionic-205-full-check.log; exit 35;
}
echo FULL_CHECK_PASS
grep -E 'Test Files|Tests |Performance budget|Performance review|threshold exceeded|budget passed' /tmp/shelly-ionic-205-full-check.log | tail -54 || true
echo CAPACITOR_SYNC_GRADLE
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android
SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"
printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$SDK" > apps/mobile/android/local.properties
(cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --quiet)
APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
test -s "$APK"
echo "APK_SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "APK_BYTES=$(wc -c < "$APK" | tr -d ' ')"
git status --short
